Looking at this problem, I need to find all possible meeting times that satisfy the constraints for all 6 participants. Let me work through this systematically.

**Key constraints to track:**
- Work hours: 9-17 local time (weekdays only)
- Sarah is 1 hour ahead, so she works 8-16 in base time
- Meetings start at :00 or :30
- Rachel: Only Mon/Thu, max 60 min
- Mary: Can miss last 10 min
- Emma: 10 min free after meeting
- Karen: Can clear meetings ≤30 min
- Olivia: 10 min free before meeting

**Rachel's availability limiting the search:**

Rachel only works Mon/Thu with these free windows:
- Monday: 9:20-9:25, 10:55-11:35, 12:45-17:00
- Thursday: 9:00-9:10, 10:10-11:00, 12:05-12:30, 13:05-13:20, 14:45-17:00

The only feasible windows for meetings starting at :00 or :30 are:
- Monday: 13:00, 13:30, 14:00, 14:30, 15:00, 15:30
- Thursday: 15:00, 15:30

**Checking Monday candidates:**

**Monday 15:30-16:00 (30 min):**
- Mary: Free after 15:05 ✓
- Sarah (base 15:30-16:00 = her time 16:30-17:00): Within work hours 9-17 local ✓
- Emma: Free after 13:40 ✓; needs 10 min after meeting, has 16:00-17:00 free ✓
- Karen: Free after 15:10 ✓; no conflicts to clear ✓
- Olivia: Free except 10:25-10:45, 12:10-12:15. Needs 10 min free before 15:30 (so 15:20-15:30) ✓
- Rachel: Within free period 12:45-17:00 ✓; 30 min ≤ 60 min ✓

**This works!** Now checking if longer meetings are possible:

**Monday 15:30-16:10 (40 min):**
- Sarah needs to attend 16:30-17:10 her time, but she ends work at 17:00 ✗

**Monday 15:30-16:30 (60 min):**
- Sarah needs to attend until 17:30 her time, past her 17:00 end ✗

**Checking Thursday candidates:**

**Thursday 15:00-15:30 (30 min):**
- Olivia: Free only at 9:00-10:00, 11:05-12:05, 12:35-14:00, 15:10-15:30, 15:35+
- So she's booked 14:00-15:10, meeting 15:00-15:30 overlaps ✗

**Thursday 15:30-16:00 (30 min):**
- Olivia: Free 15:35+, so booked 15:30-15:35. Meeting overlaps ✗

**Checking other Monday start times:**

All other Monday :00/:30 start times fail due to conflicting bookings (especially Mary's dense Monday schedule and Emma's 12:20-13:40 booking).

**Finding other 30-min options:**

I've systematically checked all :00 and :30 start times on Mon/Thu, and only **Monday 15:30-16:00** satisfies all constraints.

Therefore:
- X = 30 (longest meeting length in minutes)
- Y = 1 (only one valid option: Monday 15:30-16:00)

ANSWER: 30, 1
